Pickup lanes and helpful news
The desk is glad to help before opening
Travelers with pets should read this notice before they arrive at Aurelia Skyways. Keep animals calm, secure, and ready for staff direction at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.

Handlers use calm, humane methods and record service changes in the desk ledger. <<FACT F008>> Bring clear travel details, keep your carrier closed, and follow the lead of staff without delay. Prompt, respectful communication helps the handoff stay safe for animals and people.

Before departure, check your papers, leash, and carrier fit, then arrive with enough margin to answer standard checks. If your plans change, tell the desk at once so the record stays accurate and the move stays orderly.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk for guidance before you proceed.
